posts.title: #358: Creating a Telegram Bot
posts.description: A Telegram bot is a surprisingly practical interface for our scripts: we can trigger jobs from our phone, receive notifications from long-running tasks or query a status without building a web frontend. In this first post of a small series, we register a bot with Telegram, install the python-telegram-bot library and get a minimal bot running.

posts.title: #357: Moving PythonFriday to Zensical
posts.description: The people behind Zensical put a lot of effort into a smooth transition for MkDocs users. For Python Friday I only needed a few changes in my mkdocs.yml and one additional package to get it up and running. The rest of the migration I used to fix problems that bothered me in MkDocs for a while. Let us see what steps I had to take.

posts.title: #356: Zensical as a MkDocs Replacement
posts.description: MkDocs is, or better was, a great static site generator. I used it for various projects since 2021 and moved my blogs to MkDocs with the Material theme in 2024 . Unfortunately, the team behind MkDocs decided to move into a new direction that would mean the end to all the plugins and with that the whole ecosystem that made MkDocs such a great tool.
